reactions.description: Prenylation of polyketide pyrone substrate in the biosynthetic pathway of decalin-containing diterpenoid pyrones
Geranylgeranylation of 4-hydroxy-5,6-dimethylpyran-2-one to yield corresponding prenylated α-pyrone.
